channel.title: hwpkit
channel.description: Read, edit and extract text from Korean HWP and HWPX files in pure Python. No Hancom, no Windows. Fill forms, insert seals, feed Korean docs to a model.

item.title: 파이썬으로 HWP·HWPX 파일 읽기와 텍스트 추출하기
item.description: 파이썬으로 한글 HWP·HWPX 파일을 읽고 텍스트를 추출하고 편집하는 방법 — 한컴오피스나 윈도우 없이 순수 파이썬으로.

item.title: Read and extract Korean HWP text in Python
item.description: A practical guide to reading, extracting text from, and editing Korean HWP and HWPX (Hancom Office) files in Python — without Hancom or Windows.

item.title: Building a RAG pipeline over Korean HWP documents
item.description: Build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline over Korean HWP / HWPX documents in Python — from text extraction through chunking and embeddings.
